Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Do you discuss V:TES on more than one forum?

V:EKN has the a decent population, with 698, and hosts the vast majority of the traffic/discussion:
www.vekn.net/index.php/forum/stats

Google groups has the largest player list, with 786, but with decreasing traffic:
groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/about

White Wolf has so few posters, it is practically a blog:
forums.white-wolf.com/default.aspx?g=topics&f=19

V:TES UK has had posts from 160 accounts:
anarchfreepress.myzen.co.uk/vtesuk/index.php

Board Game Geek has 87 V:TES Fans, but no traffic:
boardgamegeek.com/forums/thing/2122/vampire-the-eternal-struggle

Michigan's V:TES forum has about 100 posters, but a similar absence of traffic:
vtes.org/

Presence has ~150 posters, but the only current traffic is for the Dallas area playgroup:
presence.vekn.org/index.php

V:TES in LA has 62 members:
vtesinla.org/index.asp

The Yahoo V:TES mailing list has 1072 members, but serves as an announcement only list:
games.groups.yahoo.com/group/vtes/

Can someone chime in for the non-English language forums?
